annotations.title: Check whether a purchase will finance

description: Checks a commercial property purchase (price, NOI, property type, owner-occupied or not, cash available) against three loan profiles: CBRE Q2 2026 average permanent loan, Freddie Mac agency multifamily, and SBA 504. Returns the max loan, cash needed and a fits/short verdict for each, at today's 10-year Treasury plus each source's spread.

cash_available.description: Cash the buyer can put in, US dollars. Omit to get cash needed without a verdict.

noi.description: Net operating income, annual, US dollars.

owner_occupied.description: True if the buyer's own business will occupy the building (SBA 504 applies only then).

property_type.description: Property type. Agency loans apply to multifamily only.

name: check_financing
title: Check whether a purchase will finance
